title: The Half Moon Peace Treaty
skyStory: Last quarter moon in Libra, half light and half dark, the most balanced the moon ever gets. Libra is thrilled. It has arranged a formal peace summit between Mars and Saturn in the middle of the sky, with a long table, two chairs and a tray of cookies. Mars wants the bigger cookie. Saturn wants a signed agreement. Libra cuts the cookie exactly in half.

reading: There is a small standoff in your week, maybe with a coworker, maybe with a stubborn task, maybe with yourself. Today the half moon offers a treaty. Meet it in the middle. Give up one small thing you were holding onto, and see what you get back.

Around 12:30 pm you will be tempted to have the last word in something. Let the other person have it instead. It will feel weird, like wearing your bracelet on the wrong wrist. The [[Two of Swords]] lowers its blindfold and grins at you. Peace is a power move, Tiger.
joel.mission: Let someone else have the last word in a conversation today, and smile about it like you know a secret.
joel.omen: Two birds sharing a feeder politely. It means a small standoff is about to resolve itself.

reading: The half moon is a reminder that you can hold two things at once. Something can be hard and also good. Something can be finished and also still growing. The Wood Rat understands this better than anyone, and today you will explain it to somebody who needs to hear it.

Your hands will do some heavy lifting in a conversation around 2 pm, drawing the shape of an idea in the air. Watch the other person's eyes follow them. That is the moment they get it. The [[Queen of Cups]] sits by the water, nodding. Treat yourself to something warm afterward.
nancy.mission: Explain something complicated today using only your hands and five words or fewer.
nancy.omen: A half-frozen puddle, half ice and half water. It means both sides of a choice can be right.
nancy.stoneWhy: a dark half for the half moon

together.text: Share a ceremonial warm drink today, separately but at the same time, as a peace treaty between Mars and Saturn. Each of you raises your mug and states one term of the treaty out loud, such as no work talk after 8 pm. Libra will witness it.
